$comment: 2026-10-23 dependency refresh: /channels measures 376.3 KB after updating Next, React and UI packages; allow 377 KB (a 2 KB increase). First-load JS per exported page, gzipped KB (scripts/bundle-size.mjs, `pnpm size` after `pnpm build`). ~5 % above the sizes of 2026-10-18; raise a budget only for a feature that needs it, after checking what grew (README: e2e/README.md#performance). 2026-10-18 evening: /collections is the same two-pane view as /collections/_ (same budget); the total grew with the calendar and date pickers, the notification bell, the collections pane and the watcher source modes. 2026-10-19: the total grew with the custom colour picker (HSV square, hue slider, hex field), the Actions section in the new-collection drawer and the clock columns of the date-time picker. 2026-10-19 posts pivot: /inbox, /collections and /items/_ are gone; /posts and /posts/_ are the two-pane view that replaced /collections (same 415 budget), /channels holds the platform grid with brand marks (360). The total grew with the post editor (Tiptap via editorcn), loaded only when the composer opens. 2026-10-20: the total grew with sign-in by email code (the code step, Settings, Account sign-in methods and their add-address drawer); the Google mark moved to its own file so /settings/account does not load the sign-in page. Later on 2026-10-20: the total grew with passkeys (add, rename, sign in), the email change drawer, per-channel link handling in the composer and the full-screen /plans page; /invite shares the sign-in code step (350). Then the billing page (/settings/billing: subscription, cards, invoices) and the upgrade and Billing entries of the user menu, which every page loads with the shell (default route 350). 2026-10-20 afternoon: /channels holds channel groups (sections, drag and drop, group dialogs) and the connect-link dialog (375; the add-channel sheet is now loaded on demand); /media is the new media library with upload, folders and tags (360; the file drawer loads on demand); /welcome stays under the default after its constants moved out of the API keys and Members pages. The total grew with seven features: River-backed jobs view, post actions and the public preview, per-platform settings, channel groups and connect links, the welcome wizard, sign-up and the media library (1310). 2026-10-20 evening: /media/edit is the media editor (OpenGPEX), its own full-screen page (280); what only the editor loads (its engine, codec glue and workers, lazy-loaded) is measured apart from the dashboard total, against editorJsGzKB (725), so it never counts toward the other pages. 2026-10-20 evening: the total grew with the image editor's dashboard side (Integrations › AI, the composer's edit hand-off; the editor's own chunks are budgeted apart), comment threads on previews, the media library's trash and duplicates, the composer tabs and collapsible channel settings, and the grouped scope picker (1360). CSS grew with the media library sidebar, the pill tabs and the editor entry points (34). /schedule holds the calendar with platform marks on its chips (360). The shell every page loads grew with the Getting started item and the pill page tabs, so the default route is 355 and /activity, which adds its event timeline, 360. 2026-10-21: the total grew with features loaded on demand: the merged Plan & usage page (plan summary, payments and invoices), the workspace time zone picker (searchable zone list), the local access token sign-in screen and its card with rotation (1395); first-load JS per route stayed at its 2026-10-20 size after the new-workspace dialog stopped pulling the zone picker into the shell. Later on 2026-10-21 the frontend audit added resilience: an error boundary inside the shell for (app) pages, a timeout on API reads and error states with Try again where lists showed an empty state on a failed load (1397). 2026-10-23: the connection error became a window over /channels (its first-load JS grew 1.3 KB); the callback page no longer loads the button, so the bundler splits the shared chunks differently and the total grew 10 KB with no route growing (1410). Later on 2026-10-23 Settings › System gained the Channels card (platforms ready to connect, a live test per channel) (1415). 2026-10-23 evening: the account picker after a sign-in that may publish as several accounts (Facebook Pages, YouTube channels...), on the callback page and the connect link page; no route went over its budget (1425). 2026-10-24: CSS grew with the audit's accessibility fixes (screen-reader prefixes, dark-mode contrast) and the page's minimum width (34.5). Later on 2026-10-24: product analytics for staqly cloud: posthog-js (no-external build with exception autocapture and web vitals, ~117 KB) is its own chunk, loaded after hydration only when the server sets POSTHOG_KEY, so self-hosted installs never fetch it (1545); the shell that starts it adds 0.5 KB to every route (/media 361).
